name: @music-theory/song-blueprint
description: The canonical song-blueprint schema (BlueprintSong/BlueprintSection/Chord) — single source of truth shared by TrackDraft, the trackdraft-bridge Ableton extension, and any ingestion/extraction adapter (docx, audio, MIDI). Extends @music-theory/song-structure's vocabulary with authoring-time fields (concept, notes, lyrics, provenance).
